summary: Một engine game đơn giản và dựa trên dữ liệu viết bằng Rust, cho phép phát triển game 2D/3D nhanh với ít boilerplate.
usecases: Rapid prototyping and development of indie 2D/3D games.
Educational purposes for learning game development with Rust.
Creating cross-platform games without engine licensing fees.
ideas: Build an ECS-based game framework for educational tutorials.
Integrate with WebGPU for browser-based Rust games.
Develop a visual editor plugin for level design within the engine.
